sn2.18:1.3: A deity of this name appears in [an5.100](), where he he identified as a former Koliyan who had been Mahāmoggallāna’s supporter. There he reports on Devadatta’s ill intent. Both discourses show a concern for ascetic conduct. | There was a river of similar name near Kusināra ([dn16:4.22.5]()), which could well have flowed through Koliyan country. Variant spellings abound in Pali and Sanskrit.
